diag.title: Check your plant's health
diag.subtitle: Take or upload a clear photo of one leaf. The diagnosis runs on your phone and works even without internet.
diag.dropHint: JPG, PNG or WEBP · up to 5 MB
diag.cameraHint: Hold one leaf flat in good daylight, filling most of the frame.
diag.samplesHint: Real test images the model never saw during training:
diag.samplesMissing: Sample images are not deployed yet.
diag.modelReady: Offline model ready — works without internet
diag.modelMissing: Offline model not available on this deployment
diag.awaitingHint: Choose a photo on the left, then tap Analyse.
diag.location: Use my location for weather risk & alerts
diag.notDeployed: The diagnosis model has not been deployed yet.
reject.title: We couldn't read this photo
reject.not_leaf: This doesn't look like a plant leaf.
reject.overexposed: The photo is too bright or washed out.
reject.tip1: Photograph one leaf at a time, filling most of the frame.
reject.tip2: Use daylight, avoid harsh shadows and direct flash.
reject.tip3: Hold the phone steady and tap the screen to focus.
result.uncertain: The model is not sure. Compare the top matches below and retake the photo for a better result.
result.slightlyBlurry: The photo is slightly blurry; results may be less reliable.
result.disclaimer: AI decision support only. For severe or unclear cases, contact your local KVK or the Kisan Call Centre (1800-180-1551).
advice.title: Treatment advice
advice.noVoice: No voice for this language is installed on this device. Please read the text.
voice.title: Ask the AI agronomist
voice.hint: Tap the mic and ask in your language, e.g. "How much should I spray per acre?"
insights.title: Farm insights
insights.defaultLocation: Using a default location. Turn on location for local weather.
forecast.title: 7-day disease risk
forecast.noSpray: No dry, calm day this week — avoid spraying before rain.
forecast.needLocation: Turn on location to see the 7-day risk forecast.
share.title: Help warn nearby farmers
share.hint: Share this result anonymously on the outbreak map. Only the crop, disease and an approximate area (~5 km) are stored.
share.queued: Saved — it will be shared when you are back online.
share.lowConfidence: Only confident results can be shared.
map.title: Crop disease outbreak map
map.subtitle: Anonymous diagnoses shared by farmers, grouped into ~5 km areas.
map.simulatedNote: Some points are simulated demo data, clearly marked.
map.alertsHint: See diseases reported within 25 km in the last 7 days.
map.noAlerts: No disease reports near you in the last 7 days.
live.hint: Hold one leaf in front of the camera. Results update automatically — no photo needed.
live.reject.not_leaf: Looking for a leaf… point the camera at one leaf
live.reject.too_dark: Too dark — move to better light
live.reject.overexposed: Too bright — avoid direct sun glare
live.reject.blurry: Hold steady — the image is blurry
live.cameraDenied: Camera permission denied. Allow camera access to use live scan.
live.cameraError: Could not start the camera on this device.
live.modelNeeded: Live scan needs the offline model, which is not available on this deployment.
